title: Mini-ofrenda competition
how: Bring a small ofrenda (base up to 12 × 12 in). Four judges score every entry; the top three win prizes.

prizes.name: LEGO Botanicals Rocking Plants
prizes.alt: LEGO Botanicals Rocking Plants set (253 pieces): two smiling potted plants, one in a green pot and one in a pink pot.

prizes.name: Hug-A-Lumps capybara plush
prizes.alt: Hug-A-Lumps weighted plush: a soft tan capybara lying down with a sleepy smile.

prizes.name: Hello Kitty Dreamy Starlight plush
prizes.alt: Hello Kitty plush with a pink star bow and a blue starry dress.
